set.body: Inventory every dense ScalaFIM image construction, access, view, mask, label, component, I/O, serialization, and algorithm boundary. Introduce one checked legacy ingress bridge that validates rank, shape, physical order, affine or NeuroSpace geometry, and ownership before producing image4s Sampled backed by Ravel. Refactor NeuroVol and NeuroVec to aliases, extensions, or narrowly scoped zero-copy compatibility views with no independent storage or geometry authority. Preserve logical (i,j,k) and (i,j,k,t) semantics; materialization must be explicit when legacy and Ravel layouts cannot share a valid view. Acceptance: representative dense workflows compile and pass, aliasing and ownership are tested, adapter allocations are measured, and no new algorithm depends on legacy raw offsets.
set.title: Migrate dense NeuroVol and NeuroVec through a checked zero-copy bridge
